20. 圖中，AC 為圓 ABCDE 的一直徑。若 ∠ADE = 28°，則 ∠CBE = ?
A. 56°
B. 62°
C. 72°
D. 76°
reasoning: Since AC is a diameter, arcs AB+BC = 180° and arcs AE+ED+DC = 180°. Angle ADE = 28° intercepts arc AE, so arc AE = 56°. Thus arcs ED+DC = 124°, and angle CBE intercepts arc CE = ED+DC, so ∠CBE = ½·124° = 62°, corresponding to option B.
